overview: The board granted two continuances for residential and commercial projects and received updates regarding board vacancies and upcoming marijuana licensing procedures. The session concluded with a closed meeting to discuss litigation strategy for several Housing Appeals Committee cases.

items.title: 4060 Mystic Valley Parkway (Case A-2022-08)
items.summary: Approved a continuance to June 30 while the eight-story laboratory project undergoes site plan review with the Community Development Board.

items.title: 29 Summer Street (Case A-2022-07)
items.summary: Continued the petition to June 30 so the applicant can provide specific square footage data required to determine if the project qualifies for a finding or necessitates a variance.

items.title: Administrative Updates
items.summary: Staff provided updates on candidate applications for the board's open seat and outlined the special permit process for pending marijuana retail and cultivation applications.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Entered executive session to discuss strategy regarding Housing Appeals Committee litigation involving MVP Mystic LLC, CID Fellsway LLC, and Combined Properties Incorporated.
